cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.
